businesses.business: Oilfield pressure control equipment and spoolable pipe

offering_description.value: Cactus designs and manufactures wellheads and pressure control equipment for oil and gas producers. It also manufactures spoolable pipe systems for production and gathering lines. It sells equipment directly and provides rentals and field services through its service centers.

primary_products.value: Wellheads; production trees; fracturing stacks and manifolds; steel-reinforced spoolable pipe; pipe fittings

primary_services.value: Pressure control equipment rental; field installation and maintenance; spoolable pipe installation support

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas producers, oilfield service companies and pipeline operators

end_markets.value: Oil and gas drilling and completion; oil and gas production; oil and gas gathering and transportation

revenue_model.value: product sales: Wellheads, production trees, spoolable pipe and fittings; rental or leasing: Fracturing stacks, manifolds and other pressure control equipment; service fees: Equipment installation, maintenance and on-site technical support
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns steel and other inputs into pressure control equipment and pipe systems for producers and pipeline operators; service provider: Deploys rental equipment and field crews for oil and gas producers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Wellhead and pressure control equipment, spoolable pipe systems, equipment rentals and field services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving oil and gas producers and pipeline operators; own locations: Company-operated service centers that supply rental equipment and dispatch field crews

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: OSHA workplace safety rules and environmental requirements for manufacturing and oilfield operations

notes: The full list of current international sales markets is uncertain.
